# hls-estimate

> Predict FPGA resource usage (LUT, FF, DSP, BRAM) and latency for a small quantized neural network, and generate synthesizable Vitis HLS C++ — without running synthesis. The analytical model's assumptions and measured error are written down, including the places it is 161% and 275% wrong.

Targets Zynq-7020, Ultra96 (ZU3EG), and PYNQ-Z2. The web estimator runs entirely in the browser; the same model ships as a Python package with a torch.fx frontend and a CLI.

## Pages

- [Estimator](https://hls-estimate.vercel.app/): pick an example network, a device, an unroll factor, and weight bits; see utilisation bars, a live device floorplan, per-layer estimates, the generated HLS C++, and the design-space Pareto front.
- [What is this?](https://hls-estimate.vercel.app/what-is-this): plain-language explanation of what the tool does and who it is for.
- [The model](https://hls-estimate.vercel.app/model): every assumption behind the analytical resource model, with measured error against published hls4ml results.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/TarunYadgirkar/hls-estimate): Python package, CLI, tests, and this web UI.
